attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Placeholder NJ military retirement exclusion. NJ exempts military pensions per N.J.S.A. 54A:6-26. Full implementation accumulates per-taxpayer military pension income; the current simplification sets the exclusion to 0 unless populated by per-income iteration in a follow-up sub-table.

New Jersey state income tax dispatcher per Form NJ-1040 / N.J.S.A. 54A. Computes NJ gross income (federal AGI as a conservative simplification), exemptions ($1,000 per taxpayer + $1,500 per dependent), taxable income, then dispatches to a bracket sub-table based on filing status.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.nj_tax = 0; set result.nj_exemption_total = 0; set result.nj_taxable_income = 0; set result.nj_agi = result.agi; set result.nj_exemption_total = length of job.taxpayers * nj_personal_exemption + length of job.dependents * nj_dependent_exemption; set result.nj_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.nj_agi - result.nj_exemption_total) and 0; add "NEW JERSEY FORM NJ-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.nj_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.nj_exemption_total xdef 0 cvd /result.nj_taxable_income xdef result.agi cvd /result.nj_agi xdef job.taxpayers length nj_personal_exemption fmul job.dependents length nj_dependent_exemption fmul f+ cvd /result.nj_exemption_total xdef result.nj_agi result.nj_exemption_total f- 0 fmax cvd /result.nj_taxable_income xdef "NEW JERSEY FORM NJ-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Joint filers use the joint bracket schedule
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "married_filing_jointly" OR job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" streq { pop job.filing_status "MFJ" streq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: MFJ -- apply joint bracket schedule via NJ_Tax_MFJ_Brackets
Single / HOH / MFS -- apply single bracket schedule via NJ_Tax_Single_Brackets
Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.nj_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.nj_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.nj_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.nj_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef
